description: Derived-evidence probability-decision MCQs for native ADJ observe/rule/prior/contributes/query programs. Each item asks the model to derive an intermediate evidence atom from observed findings, use that atom as likelihood-ratio evidence, and let ADJ map decision.leader to categorical options.

items.stem: Two diagnoses start with prior 0.05 for tuberculosis and 0.25 for bronchitis. Findings are prolonged_cough and night_sweats. Those findings derive tb_pattern. Tb_pattern has likelihood ratio 25 for tuberculosis and 0.5 for bronchitis. Which diagnosis leads?
items.program:
prior 0.05 for tuberculosis
prior 0.25 for bronchitis
contributes 25 from tb_pattern to tuberculosis
contributes 0.5 from tb_pattern to bronchitis
observe prolonged_cough
observe night_sweats
rule { head: tb_pattern when: prolonged_cough, night_sweats }
? tuberculosis
? bronchitis
